title: Byte-diff catalogue entry
description: Per-divergence ledger entry. 14 required fields per D5 (local) (rebaseline.md (local)). See skill byte-diff-catalogue.md (local) section 6.1.
$comment: D5 (local) verbatim field order (positions 1-14): entry_id, corpus, project, version, element_kind, symbol, upstream_hash, our_hash, classification, rationale, status, created_date, last_review, linked_issue. Property order is a presentation convention; JSON Schema cannot enforce it.

entry_id.description: Stable primary key; never reused. Matches the entry filename.

corpus.description: Cell dimension; one of the four supported corpora. Values match the codebase canonical names (Corpus.java enum dirName(), CI matrix, test-corpus/ directory layout). The display form 'ISO-20022' in prose docs is the standard's official name; this enum uses 'iso20022' for the machine identifier.

project.description: Sub-module within the corpus (e.g., base-model, product-model).

element_kind.description: 18+ element kinds per D15 (local). String for now; future PR may tighten to enum.

symbol.description: Fully-qualified name. Class-rule entries use synthetic prefix __class_rule__:<slug>.

upstream_hash.description: SHA-256 of upstream emission for this symbol. Sentinel e3b0c44... (sha-256 of empty string) for class-rule entries.

our_hash.description: SHA-256 of our emission. Sentinel e3b0c44... for class-rule entries.

rationale.description: Human rationale; for accepted entries cites the D-entry that locked the decision.

last_review.description: ISO-8601 date of last triage-review confirmation.

linked_issue.description: Tracker URL (upstream issue, japicmp report anchor, downstream tracker, internal follow-up). May be null.
